subject: "Error in ripple, long vectors not supported yet"

messages.author: 3b131282d2a5897d
messages.subject: "Error in ripple, long vectors not supported yet"
parts:
Hello all,

 

I was trying to order the markers in a linkage group with 751 SNPs on HPC cluster, and got the error message “Error in ripple(cross, chr = 1, window = window, verbose = FALSE) :

  long vectors not supported yet: memory.c:1648

Calls: orderMarkers -> orderMarkers.sub -> summary -> ripple”.


Is there anyone that can help me with this issue? Any comments or suggestions will be appreciated!

 

Best,

Yuanwen

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] "Error in ripple, long vectors not supported yet"
parts:
What value for window did you use? My guess is it was trying to create an unallowably large object.

karl

messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] "Error in ripple, long vectors not supported yet"
parts:
Thank you very much for the reply, Dr. Broman.


I was trying to use “g1=orderMarkers(g1,chr=1)” to establish an initial order, so I did not specify the window value yet. I am wondering will it be helpful if I use “g1=orderMarkers(g1,chr=1,use.ripple=TRUE,window=7)” instead of “g1=orderMarkers(g1,chr=1)” to decrease the object size?


I appreciate your help!


Best,

Yuanwen

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] "Error in ripple, long vectors not supported yet"

I would try use.ripple=FALSE within orderMarkers(), or reduce to window=3 just to see whether you can get it to run.

karl
